protocol: leave-one-specimen-out on the curated measured library; negative control removes the whole material

negative_control.meaning: Fraction of queries whose material was absent from the library but which still received an answer.

limitations: Queries are curated database spectra (good signal, mostly 532/785 nm, mineral specimens); user spectra of other sample types, instruments or quality will usually perform worse.
Only materials in the library can be recognised; the negative control estimates how often an absent material is wrongly named.
Perturbations are simulated and do not cover every instrument effect.
